s: [f] puM, (vidaDAtIti । vi + DA + tfc .) brahmA । ityamaraH ॥ (vizRuH । yaTA, mahABArate । 13 । 149 । 64 । “avijYAtA sahasAMSurviDAtA kftalakzaRaH ॥” “viSezeRa SezadiggajaBU BUDarAt samastaBUtAni ca daGAtIti viDAtA .” iti tatra SANkaraBAzyam ॥ * ॥ maheSvaraH । yaTA, mahABArate । 13 । 17 । 104 । “uzaNguSca viDAtA ca mAnDAtA BUtaBAvanaH ॥”) kAmadevaH । iti medinI । te, 16 ॥ madirA । iti parvvataM hantuM Sakto DAtA ca davataH । kIwena siMhaSArdUlaM maSakena gajaM taTA ॥ SiSunA ca mahAvIraM mahAntaM kzudrajantuBiH । BUzikeRa ca mArjjAraM maRqUkena BujaNgamam ॥ evaM janyena janakaM 7 aDyAyaH ॥ api ca । Balandana uvAca । “sambanDo hi viDivaSo na me sADyo vrajADipa । prajApatiryogakarttA janmadAtAhameva ca ॥ kA kasya patnI kanyA vA varaH ko vA sasADanaH ॥ karmmAnurUpaPaladaH nivAryyate ॥” iti brahmavEvartte SrIkfzRajanmaKaRqe 17 aH ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “tyAge dozaH kAmukInAM SApaBAk pApaBAk gfhI । brahmA jagadbiDAtApi na viraktaH kalatravAn । tyAge dozastat kadAcinnAsmAkaM tyaktayozitAm ॥” * ॥ aparaYca । “svAntarduHKena duHKArtto yo yaM Sapati niScitam । taM SApaM KaRqituM Sakto na viDAtA jagatpraBuH ॥” iti brahmavEvartte SrIkfzRajanmaKaRqe 20 aH ॥ * ॥ asO jagatAM patiryaTA, -- “dvO DAtA ca viDAtA ca pOrARO jagatAM patI । dvO SAstArO triloke'smin DarmmADarmmO prakIrttitO ॥” iti vahripurARe gaRaBedanAmADyAyaH ॥ (tri, meDAvI । iti niGaRwuH । 3 । 15 ॥ vihitakarmmAnuzWAtA । yaTA, manuH । 11 । 35 । “viDAtA SAsitA vaktA metrI brAhmaRa ucyate । tasmE nAkuSalaM brUyAt na SuzkAM giramIrayet ॥” srazwA । sarvvasaBarTaH । yaTA, raGuH । 1 । 70 । “tayA hInaM viDAtarmAM kaTaM paSyanna dUyase । siktaM svayamiva snehAdvanDyamASramapAdapam ॥” janayitA । dAtA । yaTA, kumAre । 1 । 57 । “svayaM viDAtA tapasaH PalAnAM kenApi kAmena tapaScacAra ॥”)

m: वि-घात m. a stroke, blow with (comp.), VarBṛS.
breaking off or in pieces, ib.
driving back, warding off, MBh.; R.
destruction, ruin, Kāv.; Var.; Pañcat.
removal, prohibition, prevention, interruption, impediment, obstacle, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
failure, want of success, Jātakam.
a: विघातः — 1 Destruction, removing, warding off; क्रियादवानां मघवा विघातं Ki. 3. 52. --2 Killing, slaying. --3 An obstacle, impediment, interruption; opposition, prevention; क्रियाविघाताय कथं प्रवर्तसे R. 3. 44; अध्वरविघातशांतये 11. 1. --4 A blow, stroke. --5 Abandoning, leaving. --Comp. --सिद्धिः f. the removal of obstacles.

m: वि-˚घातक mfn. impeding, interrupting, MBh.; Bh.
वि-˚घातन mfn. warding off, averting, MBh.
वि-˚घातन n. impeding, interrupting, disturbing, R.; Suśr.
वि-˚घातन—सिद्धि f. the settling or removal of obstacles or impediments, W.

m: वि-˚घातिन् mfn. fighting, slaying, MBh.; Hariv.
hurting, injuring, Vet.
opposing, impeding, preventing, interrupting, R.; Kathās.
विघूणिका f. the nose, L.
वि-√ घूर्ण् P. Ā. -घूर्णति, ˚ते, to roll or whirl about, be agitated, MBh.; R.
वि-˚घूर्णन n. (or f(आ). ) swaying to and fro, Kād.
वि-˚घूर्णित mfn. rolled about, rolling, shaken, agitated, MBh.; R. &c.
a: विघूर्णित — p. p. Rolled, shaken about, rolling (as eyes).

cloudless (loc. ‘under a cloudless sky’), MBh.
2. वि-घन mfn. (√ हन्; for 1. See p. 950, col. 2) injuring, hurting, MantraBr.
वि-घन m. an implement for striking, mallet, hammer, TS.; ĀpŚr.
वि-घन m. N. of two Ekāhas, Br.; ŚrS. (-त्व n., TBr.)
वि-घन m. N. of Indra, Kāṭh.
a: विघनः — 1 A mallet, hammer. --2 One who destroys, subdues or overpowers.

m: वि-घन—त्व n., TBr.
1. वि—घ˚नेन्दु m. a cloudless moon, MW.
वि-˚घनिन् mfn. slaying, killing, RV. vi, 60, 5 (Sāy.)
वि-घर्षण n. (√ घृष्) rubbing, Dhātup.
विघसाश (MBh.) or विघसा˚शिन् (Mn.), mfn. one who eats the remains of an offering.

the residue of an oblation of food (offered to the gods, to deceased ancestors, to a guest, or to a spiritual preceptor), Mn.; MBh. &c. (˚सम् बहु-√ कृ, to make an ample meal).
a: विघसः — 1 Half-chewed morsel, the residue or leavings of food eaten; विघसो भुक्तशेषं तु Ms. 3. 285; तृप्यत्कालकरालवक्त्रविघसव्याकीर्यमाणा इव U. 5. 6; Māl. 5. 14. --2 Food in general. --सं Bees'-wax. --Comp. --आशः, --आशिन् m. one who eats the remains of an offering or of food eaten.

k.v: त्रिष्वथ क्रतुकर्मेष्टं पूर्तं खातादि कर्म यत्. अमृतं विघसो यज्ञशेषभोजनशेषयोः॥

m: वि-√ घट् (often confounded with वि-√ घट्ट्) Ā. -घटते, to go or fly apart, become separate, disperse, Kāv.; to be broken or interrupted or marred or frustrated or destroyed, Rājat.; Hit. : Caus. -घटयति, to tear or rend asunder, separate, disperse, Prab.; Hit.; to mar, frustrate, annihilate, destroy, Mṛcch.; Rājat.
a: विघट् — {c1c} A. 1 To be disunited or separated. --2 To be spoiled or ruined. --3 To be stopped, break down. --4 To assume various shapes; Māl. 9. 24. --Caus. 1 To separate, disperse, tear apart; विघटयंत्यग्रेनभोंऽभोमुचः Māl. 5. 2. --2 To remove, displace.

m: वि-˚घटन n. breaking up, separation, dispersion, destruction, ruin, Prab.; Sāh.

a: विघटिका — A measure of time equal to one-sixtieth part of a Ghaṭikā (or nearly equal to 24 seconds).

m: वि-˚घटित mfn. broken, separated, divided, severed, Rājat.; Prab.

m: वि-√ घट्ट् (cf. वि-√ घट्) Ā. -घट्टते, to smash or break to pieces, Prasannar.; P. -घट्टयति, to strike or force asunder, open (a door), sever, disperse, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to shake, stir, rub against, ib.; Suśr.
a: विघट्ट् — {c10c} U. 1 To strike down, disperse, scatter, scare away; Śi. 1. 64; Bh. 3. 54. --2 To rub, strike, rub against; कारंडवाननविघट्टितवीचिमालाः Rs. 3. 8; 4. 9; विघटृइतानां सरलद्रुमाणां Ku. 1. 9 Ki. 8. 45; Śi. 8. 24, 13. 41. --3 To break, violate (as an agreement). --4 To break asunder, burst open (as a door).

m: वि-˚घट्टना f. striking against, Śiś.
rubbing, friction, Bālar.
separation, Nalod.
वि-˚घट्टनीय mfn. to be shaken or broken (मनः विघट्ट˚नीयम्, ‘one should rack or cudgel one's brains about’, with loc.), Siṃhās.
to be forced asunder or broken open, to be separated or set at variance, MW.
वि-˚घट्टन mfn. opening, Hariv.
वि-˚घट्टन n. rubbing, friction, Śiś.
moving to and fro, stirring, shaking (also pl.), Bālar.; Suśr.
striking against, Śiś.
striking asunder, forcing apart, hewing in pieces, Inscr.; Vcar.; Kād.
loosening, untying, Ragh.
a: विघट्टनं --ना — 1 Striking asunder. --2 Striking against, friction. --3 Separating, undoing, untying. --4 Offending, hurting.

m: वि-˚घट्टिन् mfn. (ifc.) rubbing, Ragh.

violated, betrayed, MBh.
untied, undone, W.
hurt, offended, MW.
a: विघट्टित — p. p. 1 Struck apart, severed, separated, dispersed; Bh. 3. 54. --2 Untied, loosened, opened. --3 Rubbed, touched. --4 Shaken about, churned. --5 Hurt, offended.

a: विघृष्ट — p. p. 1 Rubbed excessively. --2 Sore.

(ep. also n.) an obstacle, impediment, hindrance, opposition, prevention, interruption, any difficulty or trouble, Kauś.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
N. of Gaṇeśa, Up.
Carissa Carandas, L.
वि-घ्न &c. See p. 957, col. 3.
a: विघ्नः — [विहन्-क] (rarely n.) 1 An obstacle, interruption, impediment, a hindrance; कुतो धर्मक्रियाविघ्नः सतां रक्षितरि त्वयि Ś. 5. 14; मूर्तो विघ्नस्तपस इव नः Ś. 1. 33; हुंकारेणेव धनुषः स हि विघ्नानपोहति Ś. 3. 1; Ku. 3. 40. --2 Difficulty, trouble. --Comp. --ईशः, --ईशानः, --ईश्वरः epithets of Gaṇeśa. ˚वाहनं a rat. --कर, --कर्तृ, --कारिन् a. opposing, obstructing. --ध्वंसः, --विघातः removal of obstacles. --नायकः, --नाशकः, --नाशनः epithets of Gaṇeśa. --प्रतिक्रिया removal of impediments; R. 15. 4. --राजः --विनायकः, --हारिन् m. epithets of Gaṇeśa. --सिद्धिः f. removal of obstacles.

k.v: हिंसाकर्माभिचारः स्याज्जागर्या जागरा द्वयोः। विघ्नोऽन्तरायः प्रत्यूहः स्यादुपघ्नोऽन्तिकाश्रये॥

वि-घ्न—कर्तृ mfn. id., MBh.; Pañcar.
वि-घ्न—कृत् mfn. = -कर, RPrāt.; VarBṛS. &c.
